## Core Research Discipline & Pipeline
Dr. Jaswanth operates an end-to-end bench-to-computation translational research pipeline:
1. Plant Biotechnology & Conservation: Somatic embryogenesis, multiple shoot induction, and micropropagation in endangered medicinal succulent taxa (Caralluma fimbriata, Caralluma bhupenderiana) and Bacopa monnieri.
2. Elicitor Regulation & Metabolic Enhancement: Abiotic and biotic elicitation (jasmonic acid, salicylic acid, NaCl stress) in plant suspension cultures to trigger secondary metabolite hyperaccumulation.
3. Analytical Chemistry & Metabolomics: Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) and Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FT-IR) metabolic fingerprinting and peak deconvolution.
4. In Silico Virtual Screening: Molecular docking (AutoDock Vina) and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to characterize binding affinities of plant secondary metabolites against disease-associated macromolecular targets.
5. Controlled-Environment Agriculture (CEA): Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) hydroponics optimization, monitoring electrical conductivity (EC), pH, and crop yield dynamics in Spinacia oleracea and Capsicum annuum.
6. Genome Editing Competency: Hands-on training in CRISPR-Cas design and genome editing applications through the Agri Biotech Foundation and Federation of Asian Biotech Associations (FABA).
